title: Structured output integrity gate and changelist impact detector
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Goal: Build an automated integrity gate that detects quality regressions specific to structured outputs (JSON / contract-style responses) triggered by model or configuration changes. The gate should run as part of change pipelines (PRs / model rollouts) and surface deterministic schema violations, semantic field-level regressions (missing/incorrect fields), and distributional drift on key fields used downstream.

Scope:
- A lightweight targeted eval runner that executes a curated dataset (golden records + edge cases) for structured-output endpoints when a model config or runtime setting changes.
- Schema diffing with clear delta reporting (field missing/extra, type changes, enum drift).
- Quantitative metrics per-field (coverage, invalid_fraction, avg_token_gap for truncated values) and a composite regression score.
- Configurable thresholds per-route/model that fail gates locally (CI) or open an alert for canary rollouts.
- Integration points: GitHub Actions / CI, Redwood Console alerts, Rollouts auto-fallback hook.

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- Use a snapshot + targeted perturbation approach (fast) rather than full large-scale evals for PRs to keep CI cost low. Full evaluations run as asynchronous background jobs for major releases.
- Strike balance between strict schema enforcement and pragmatic tolerance: provide soft-fail (warning) and hard-fail modes. Default to soft-fail for models with high variability.
- Prefer deterministic JSON linting + schema-aware normalization (strip timestamps, sort lists by key heuristics) before diffing to reduce noisy alerts.
- Field-level semantic checks (e.g., addresses, dates) will be heuristic-based initially; plan to add model-assisted validators in phase 2 for higher fidelity.

Acceptance criteria:
- A CI hook that can be included in model/config PRs which runs the structured-output integrity gate against a configurable 100-500 sample golden set and returns pass/warn/fail.
- Delta report produced as markdown artifact with per-field metrics and example failure traces.
- Console integration: a new "Schema Gate" alert card that appears on rollout pages and links to the delta artifact.
- Rollout policy support: when in hard-fail mode, block canary promotion if composite regression score exceeds threshold.

Implementation plan (phases):
- Phase 0 (spike): prototype runner that loads schema, runs 200 golden examples against model variant, and emits basic schema diff. (Done)
- Phase 1 (CI integration + metrics): implement CI Action, store artifacts in S3, wire per-field telemetry to metrics ingestion. (In progress)
- Phase 2 (console + rollout hooks): display deltas in Console, integrate with rollout policies and fallback automation.
- Phase 3 (scale & heuristics): add model-assisted validators, configurable tolerances per-customer, and automatic golden-set selection.

Implementation notes:
- Use existing structured-output eval harness but extract a lightweight runner binary (go/python) that can run in GitHub Actions.
- Persist artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/schema-gate/{run_id} and expose signed URLs in PR comments.
- Telemetry schema: tags=[route,model,change_id], metrics=[invalid_fraction, missing_fields, extra_fields, composite_score].
- Policy defaults: composite_score > 0.15 => warn; > 0.30 => fail in hard-fail mode. Thresholds are configurable per-route.

Links & artifacts:
- Spike notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVALS/Schema+Gate+Spike
- Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/428
- Golden dataset bucket (internal): s3://redwood-evals/golden/structured-output-v1
- Dashboard mock: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/schema-gate-mock

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: High false positive rate for open-ended fields (free text). Mitigation: allow field-level tolerance and gradually onboard stricter checks for only structured fields.
- Risk: CI cost if golden sets grow. Mitigation: sample curation and use run-on-change heuristics (run full set only for model-major-version bumps).

Next steps:
- Finish CI Action integration and open upstream PR to embed it into model SDK pipelines.
- Add Console card prototype in the rollout details page.
- Coordinate with PM & Design for UX text for warnings and remediation steps.
